description: DuckDB tests that need functionality duckdb_object_storage does not provide yet. Remove entries once the feature lands.

skip_tests.reason: Opening a DuckDB database file that was not written through duckdb_objfs://: 'load <file> readonly' maps to a read-only duckdb_objfs://mapped_<hash>.db, which does not exist because fixture databases, unzipped files and files written through a local ATTACH are never imported into object storage.
